# Job Posting: Accounts Assistant (Full-Time)

Aoba Trading Inc., Finance Department

Posted: Thursday, October 1, 2026

## The role

- Position: Accounts Assistant
- Employment: full-time, permanent
- Location: Chiyoda, Tokyo (head office)
- Salary: $70,000–$90,000 a year, depending on experience

## What you will do

You will post daily entries, process payments, close the books each month and work with our outside tax accountants.

## Requirements

### Required

- A degree in accounting or finance
- At least three years of bookkeeping experience
- Spreadsheet formulas for monthly reports

### Preferred

- Experience with consolidated accounts
- Reading business documents in Japanese

## Working hours

9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. (a one-hour break, 8 hours of work)

## Holidays

Weekends, public holidays and the New Year break (125 days a year)

## How to apply

Send your resume and a cover letter by email to Rachel Whitford, our recruiting coordinator, by Friday, October 30, 2026.

Rachel Whitford will reply about the first screening within two weeks.

Questions: Rachel Whitford, Finance Department
